functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_hud_element_alignment_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_hud_element_alignment_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Apply the selected Modern HUD edge origin at the first instruction reached only after the element asset exists, beyond the asset-null branch delay slot and before DKR copies its display-list cursor.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_hud_element_alignment_end(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_hud_element_alignment_end(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Restore neutral rectangle and viewport origins after the element draw and DKR's own bounce offsets have been restored, preventing HUD alignment from leaking into later world or overlay rendering.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_minimap_alignment_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_minimap_alignment_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Right-anchor DKR's directly rendered minimap plate in Modern HUD modes; its marker elements are aligned independently through hud_element_render.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_minimap_alignment_end(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_minimap_alignment_end(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Restore neutral HUD origins immediately after the minimap plate draw so the setting cannot affect subsequent scene geometry.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_telemetry_simulation_tick(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_telemetry_simulation_tick(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Count authoritative game-loop ticks at the decompiled DKR simulation boundary so Modern presentation work can be proven independent from gameplay, input, and audio cadence.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_presentation_frame_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_presentation_frame_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Reset only the matrix-identity sidecar for the display-list buffer selected for the new authored frame, after DKR has submitted and toggled the previous buffer.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_presentation_task_submitted(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_presentation_task_submitted(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Freeze the completed frame's semantic matrix sidecar immediately before DKR builds and submits its graphics task, preserving exact FIFO ownership even when rendering is delayed beyond N64 double-buffer reuse.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_presentation_scene_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_presentation_scene_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Advance the Modern scene generation at the decompiled level lifecycle boundary so no object or matrix history can cross a load, restart, warp, or cutscene level transition.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_apply_gameplay_fov(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_apply_gameplay_fov(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Apply the Modern gameplay FOV offset after reading the authored level value and before cam_set_fov, leaving character select, menus, cutscenes, simulation and Accurate mode unchanged.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_extended_frustum_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_extended_frustum_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Temporarily widen DKR's CPU side-plane reference points for the active expanded-aspect viewport so geometry remains visible across ultrawide displays.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_extended_frustum_end(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_extended_frustum_end(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Restore the exact authored CPU frustum reference table before returning so Modern culling state cannot leak into another viewport, profile or frame.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_extend_object_draw_distance(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_extend_object_draw_distance(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Scale the local Modern object draw-distance value before DKR's original multiplayer reduction and fade calculation, preserving authored object data and Accurate behavior.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_presentation_object_spawned(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_presentation_object_spawned(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Assign a new host-side lifetime generation to each successfully spawned DKR object; null failure returns are ignored.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_presentation_object_freed(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_presentation_object_freed(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Retire an object's interpolation lifetime before DKR queues it for destruction so reuse of the same heap address cannot revive old transform history.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_presentation_object_begin(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_presentation_object_begin(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Capture the visible object's stable identity and first matrix pointer after DKR's invisible/shadow-only early return and before object-part rendering begins.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_presentation_object_end(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_presentation_object_end(rdram, ctx);
functionHooks.reason: Bind the exact contiguous matrix range produced by this object to hierarchical per-matrix identities before DKR restores its caller-owned render pointers.

functionHooks.reason: Validate Rare's uninitialized physical-voice auxiliary-bus selector before it becomes a host RDRAM pointer.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_transition_cover_end(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_transition_cover_end(rdram, ctx);

functionHooks.reason: Clear a stale music-change lock exactly before character select starts its intended sequence, preventing intro music and character channel arrangements from layering on first entry.

functionHooks.text: extern void dkr_character_select_animation_tick(uint8_t*, recomp_context*); dkr_character_select_animation_tick(rdram, ctx);

functionHooks.reason: Use the deterministic beat phase only for character-select model animation after the original audio clock bookkeeping, preserving every other music-synchronised effect.
